name: Smart Lamp Mini
author: buildwithnoknok
description: The smallest Smart Lamp: a USB LEDs module for light and one LED Button for everything else. Short press steps through five brightness levels and off; hold it for a second to change the colour. Pick any colour or brightness in the app.
assembly_guide: Connect the USB LEDs module to the DataHub, and the DataHub to the PicoHub.
Connect the LED Button to a PicoHub I2C port.
Run setup in the noknok app.

controls.action: Next colour — one step per hold, 12 colours
Shows the lamp colour while the lamp is on
Factory reset — keep holding until the LED flashes (about 8 s)

config_schema.label: Brightness
config_schema.help: The button steps through 5 levels; set any value here.

config_schema.label: Lamp colour
config_schema.help: Holding the button steps through 12 preset colours; pick any colour here.
